q1_issues.issue: (Degree (sk_contain $x) quantity high) attaches Degree to an EVENT, while the quantity form of Degree is specified to sit on the noun's witness, and "high" is not one of its three licensed markers (excessive / insufficient / sufficient); the head noun "level(s)" is dropped entirely (repeated verbatim in statements 7 and 8).

The sealed Theme term embeds two (Implication ...) rules, so rule variables $x occur free inside an ordinary asserted atom — sealing is specified for propositions (single atom or (And ...)), not for rules, and the Skolem machinery forbids free/unbound variables.

The bare plural subject "Studies" is given a definite-style group witness (GroupOf sk_studies_1 study), whereas a bare plural is the generic on the instruction set's own determiner test (groups are for definite / demonstrative / possessed plurals).

q2_gaps: existential / episodic bare-plural subject ("Studies have found that P", "dogs were barking outside") — bare plurals are mapped only to the generic (kind / rule) reading, leaving no form for a bare plural that reports particular instances

"high levels of <mass>" — a qualitative (non-numeric, non-proportional) amount of a mass noun has no licensed encoding: Measure needs a magnitude+unit, ProportionOf needs a whole, and Degree's quantity slot admits only excessive / insufficient / sufficient
an attitude complement that is itself a GENERIC — sealing a distributing (Implication ...) rule under Theme, and the status of its rule variables inside the seal, is unaddressed
"find (that)" is in neither the factive nor the non-factive verb list, so whether P projects to top level is left to the parser (this parse treats it as factive, dual-emitting the rules)
notes: The good parts: "both green and black ... leaves" is correctly distributed into two independent predications rather than a Cardinality 2, the fused compound kinds get head-noun genus only (noun modifiers are never exposed), and a stative transitive "contain" rightly keeps Agent/Theme. A plausible alternative route the instruction set arguably prescribes is the bare-kind relational generic (Contain green_tea_leaf aluminum), since both arguments are close to bare kind NPs.
